description: This file defines the 'uploader' class which handles file uploads, including validation, resizing, thumbnail creation, localization, and integration with external editors (like CKEditor and TinyMCE) for a web-based file management component.

classes.name: uploader
classes.description: A class managing file uploads, including validation, resizing, thumbnail creation, localization, and integration with editors like CKEditor and TinyMCE.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the uploader class, setting up configurations, directories, localization, and session.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles the file upload process: validation, moving files, thumbnail creation, and callback invocation.

methods.name: checkUploadedFile
methods.description: Validates the uploaded file for errors, extension, and optional resizing.

methods.name: checkInputDir
methods.description: Validates and normalizes an input directory path.

methods.name: validateExtension
methods.description: Checks if the file's extension is permitted for the current type.

methods.name: getTypeFromPath
methods.description: Extracts the type from a given path.

methods.name: removeTypeFromPath
methods.description: Removes the type prefix from a path.

methods.name: imageResize
methods.description: Resizes an image to fit within configured max dimensions.

methods.name: makeThumb
methods.description: Creates a thumbnail for an image if possible.

methods.name: localize
methods.description: Loads language-specific labels and locale settings.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Retrieves a localized label string, replacing placeholders with provided data.

methods.name: backMsg
methods.description: Displays an error message and terminates execution.

methods.name: callBack
methods.description: Outputs the upload result and invokes the appropriate callback for editors or custom handlers.

methods.name: get_htaccess
methods.description: Returns default .htaccess content to disable PHP execution in upload directories.
